goal: Reject Tapscript Miniscript descriptors containing keys that differ only in parity prefix
Prevent third parties from malleating transactions by altering execution branches without private keys
agreement: Substantive support with tests verifying that duplicate keys are rejected under Tapscript (fametrano)
Suggestion to adjust test assertions for successful cases was resolved (achow101)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it fixes a validation flaw that accepts non-sane Tapscript Miniscript descriptors
Descriptors with identical x-only keys allow third parties to malleate transactions on chain
